name: sfagent-tools
description: AI-powered testing and evaluation for Salesforce Agentforce agents. Run headless conversations, validate behavior, and generate reports.

interface.shortDescription: Headless conversation testing for Salesforce Agentforce agents
interface.longDescription: Tell Codex what to test. It reads your Agentforce agent's brain, runs headless conversations, finds what's broken, and gives you a scored report with fix recommendations. Built on the Salesforce CLI and Agent API so authentication and traces stay native. Generates YAML specs compatible with `sf agent test run-eval` for CI hand-off.
defaultPrompt: Generate tests for my Agentforce agent
Run guardrail tests against my Agentforce agent
Test the Resort_Manager agent with multi-turn booking scenarios
Find edge cases for my agent's subagent routing
